name: Takamine Kazufumi
source:
The protagonist's father. 

He makes a living doing art and interior design commissions, mostly as a front for him to go overseas and check out different countries.

He and Nozomi's father are longtime friends, so their families are well-acquainted.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.yuzu-soft.com/products/stella/character.html]official website[/url]]
